en: My creator needs my help, and I won't let her down.
I'll do whatever it takes to save Miss Shelly.
Miss Shelly's a good person, and probably wouldn't condone me participating in bloodsport for money. I, however, am not shackled by human morality, and find it a rather entertaining use of my time.
Miss Shelly is taking her nap. I probably got enough time to contact some godlike creature!
People get me all wrong. I'm not interested in violence for violence's sake! I'm interested in violence for money's sake.
A little trouble never hurt anyone!
The only way this day gets any better is if I get to punch Lash in the face.
Ready to start some trouble with me, mates?
Who wants to play with ol' Bebop, ay?
Facing me's the last mistake they're gonna make.
'Fraid I gotta get back to the junkyard.
Good. More time for me to work out new ways to hurt Lash.
Can't. Miss Shelly needs my help.
Just promise me you won't work with Lash?
Not a choice I'd make, but hey, it's your life.
Miss Shelly's having one of her good days so, I'm gonna spend time with her while I can.
There's work to be done at the junkyard.
You'll be fine without me. Miss Shelly, though? She needs me.
Hey, Bebop. Just... do me a favor: If I'm punching someone in the face, please don't knock 'em away!
Do my best, mate, but I make no promises.
Now, I'm not trying to cast aspersions, Detective, but in my experience organics don't tend to last long in a fight.
Pal, the only thing you gotta worry about is keeping up.
I punch things. How about you?
Oh, this is gonna be fun.
Given the sword, I'm assuming you like to be up close?
Good. I'll bring 'em to us, you finish 'em off.
How do you think I'd fare in the Bear Pit?
You'd probably get your arse kicked.
Ah, it's not a knock on you, I'm sure you're a helluva talent. But fighting for points is very different than fighting to eat.
Don't worry about me, Bebop. I'll be fine.
Hey, Bebop. The old lady that made you-
Shut your mouth, Billy. I'm not in the mood.
So. You work at a scrapyard.
That's the best you're gonna get, Tin Man.
Alright, Tin Man. Bring 'em in, and let my bat do the work.
Mate... I've got a bloody laser. What's a bat gonna do?
You're a good little boy that does what he's told, aren't you?
If you're half as good as people say you are, you should be working as an assassin, not a pit fighter.
I'm not interested in killing people for money.
But you're perfectly fine putting people in the hospital for money.
It's an arbitrary, yet distinct, line.
If I bring 'em to us, can you finish 'em off?
I work with some pretty big Lash fans.
How would you like this to work?
If you see someone chased by a Glitter Ball, knock 'em into their friends.
You know, you and your maker should come to the show sometime. I can get you free tickets!
Well, that sounds lovely. I'm not sure Miss Shelly's health would allow it, though.
I mean, after today, her health's not supposed to be an issue, right?
That's true. I-I'm just tryna be polite.
Bebop, if we survive the ritual, please let me treat Miss Shelly to a spa day at The Baroness.
That’s rather kind of you. Thank you!
I wish I could offer more for her...
Well, that’s what the Patrons are for, mate.
So, uh... whatcha plan on doing once I pull 'em in?
That… kinda defeats the purpose of me pullin' ‘em in, right?
This isn’t gonna go well, is it?
Not the ideal pairing, no... but I’m sure we can make it work.
You look a little rough around the edges, mate.
Been traveling a long way to get here. Haven't had time to rest up and... get a proper meal.
In that case, you should come over to the scrapyard after the ritual! I'm sure Miss Shelly could help out with dinner.
Thanks for giving me something to look forward to, Bebop.
I'll pull 'em in close to you, Drifter!
Well, aren't you a thoughtful little scrap golem?
How long are you planning on being in New York?
Hmph, countin' the days until I'm gone?
Oh, I wasn't made, my body was just obliterated by an Astral Gate.
Shame. I thought I'd found a kindred spirit.
Listen, we're both just a couple of floating souls in iron bodies. I think there's plenty of common ground.
Don't worry, Professor. If anyone escapes your black hole, I'll be sure to pull 'em back in.
Bebop, you are a gentleman and I appreciate you.
You know, you seem remarkably polite for a pit-fighter!
Miss Shelly stresses the importance of etiquette.
Well, she should be proud of her son.
I like to think she is.
Your parents know you're out here?
I'm a little older than you, miss.
Can you get off my back, you little robo-hypocrite?
I'd do anything for her. I imagine you feel the same way about your parents.
Look, the dead aren't very bright, okay? If any of them get in the way, I'm sorry.
Appreciate the 'eads up. I'll make it work.
I've... never worked with a golem before.
I'm not sure why you'd think it would be any different from working with a person.
Now I feel like an asshole.
Yeah. Seems like a lot of people are scared of you.
Is it true you were in the Baxter Society?
I was one of the founding members.
Whew, I bet you have a lot of stories.
I do. Some of them even have happy endings.
You're loyal to your creator, Bebop. It's an admirable quality.
When this is over... the OSIC isn't gonna take me away from Miss Shelly, right?
Of course not. We fight monsters, not act like them.
Don't you kill people in their dreams?
That was more of a royal we.
Don't see too many golems in Macomb.
Don't see too many cowboys in New York.
Isn't a sheriff just a cowboy with a badge?
I'll pull them in, you grab 'em?
I like the way you think, tin man!
I know it's against your nature... programming, or whatever. But there are gonna be times when I need you not to punch someone right after you pull 'em.
Hmm... you're right that it does seem rather counter-intuitive.
Just let me grab them first. Then feel free to beat the hell out of them.
You worked at the scrapyard, right? The one the old lady runs?
I didn't realize you two were acquainted.
We're not. I just, um... I just wanted to make sure she's doin' okay.
You think we can win this thing, tin man?
Why couldn't I have been paired up with a bouncer instead of a bartender?
Ah, don't worry about me, Bebop. I know how to take care of myself.
You want me to carry you around the city? It's kind of fun!
Might be a little too heavy for you, miss.
I'm stronger than I look, mister golem!
Why do you fight people for money?
Why do you fight people for free?
Because if I didn't, people would have died.
You and Miss Shelly should come over to the Arroyos for dinner sometime. I bet they'd get along great!
That sounds rather nice, Ivy. Thank you!
Ah, just worried about Miss Shelly, is all.
I understand. Just know that I'll do whatever I can to help you both.
I'm still a little confused on your condition. Are you alive or dead?
I wish I knew. Little of both, I suppose.
Well, that doesn't make any sense.
It makes as much sense as me talking to an animated scrap pile, yes?
Not really. I was summoned into existence by an act of craftsmanship, willpower and sacrifice. There's a clear path that someone could replicate. You're a pseudo-corpse with a glowing rock!

Well, Miss Shelly loved reading about your adventures. When you disappeared, it was sad thinking about her not being able to read a new one before she died... but now that you're back, let's hope for one more story.
There'll be more than one, my friend.
Great. I'm stuck working with an automaton.
Ah bien super, maintenant je suis coincé avec un bourgeois. (Ha, great. I'm stuck with an upper-class.)
Apologies. I didn't realize I was working with a man of culture.
Geist. Are you doctor Johann's sister?
You're not one of those machines that value human life, are you?
Not particularly. Beyond a few... notable exceptions.
Wonderful. We'll get along just fine.
Don't worry, Bebop. Miss Cheri is gonna be a-okay now that you asked The Lash for help.
Of course the Patron has us working together...
I'd ask you to not to suck, but The Lash doesn't believe in miracles.

At some point during the ritual, you're gonna do something outrageously stupid, and I'm gonna save your life. And I want you to know that when I do? I'm gonna lord it over you for the rest of your days.
Impossible. Cause when I win, I'm going to wish for a world without Bebop.
You are so full of shit.
You gonna throw this to make me look bad?
My love for Miss Shelly is more than my hate for you. We're gonna win this thing... I just hope you die in the process.
Then I guess it's a good thing that crushing hopes... is what I do best.
Well. When you see her, tell her she did great work.
Your commitment to ordinance is impressive, McGinnis!
Eh, I like blowing things up.
So, what sort of bindings did your creator put on you?
Uh, rules that you're required to follow.
More like... the unethical enforcement of ethics.
Oh, Miss Shelly doesn't believe in that sort of thing.
So, what's stopping you from mowing down humanity with that death laser?
You smell like garbage and motor oil.
I work in a scrap yard.
Miss Shelly says you shouldn't judge someone based on what they do.
Yeah, well, Miss Shelly is probably poor, so of course she would say that.
Don't you talk about my mother like that.
Do you like being a vampire?
Honestly? It's kind of lame. Anytime there's a vampire salon, I have to hang out with a bunch of old people.
Can't you just... skip the salon?
No no no no no, you don't skip a salon. Not showing up is seen as a snub, and the only thing worse than a boring old vampire, is an angry vampire.
So... what do you do? Throw a boomerang?
Why would I throw a boomerang?
Cause you're like an Australian robot or whatever?
[Sigh] Okay... so 1: I was created in America. 2: I sound British, not Australian.
Why would she make you sound like that?
That's a question for her, not me.
You care about Nashala's safety, right?
Then why are you taking her into a fight?
What would you have me do? Stick her in a dresser at her hotel? No. She's safer with me.
Bebop. Today your courage is required.
If it means saving Miss Shelly, I'll take 'em all on meself.
How do you like our chances?
I try not to think about questions like that. Underconfidence can be just as dangerous as overconfidence.
Alright boys, when I pull 'em in, I need you to be ready to grab 'em.
You can count on us, Bebop.
Great job at the fights the other night.
Thanks mate. That might've been my last night.
All goes well today, I won't need to fight in the pit any more.
Bebop, you have a gift. One that we can gamble on. Please don't waste it.
Sorry we couldn't do more for her.
Ah, you tried. That's good enough.
Would you mind coming over to read to Miss Shelly sometime? I think she'd enjoy it.
I, um... I'm not trying to be rude, but... you don't strike me as a particuarly violent person.
Well... if he's anything like you, I'm sure he's a good person.
Looks like you have your hands full.
Apologies. Normally I would offer to help carry your books for ya, but I'm afraid I need my hands for murderous intent.
You're a marvel to behold, Bebop. Truly exquisite craftsmanship.
I can't wait to see it.
Between the two of us, we'll put them right where we want them.
Looking forward to working with you, Paradox!
"Bebop". That's a curious name for a golem.
Eh, Miss Shelly's a fan of music.
Sadly, no. These hands aren't exactly, uh... delicate.
Are you gonna let a little thing like "hands" stop you?
S'pose so, but... I bet there's a solution if you try hard enough.
You're fighting to save your mom, right?
Hah. Must be nice having a mother worth saving.
Pocket. I don't mean to pry, but... if after the ritual, you need a place to stay...
That's... very kind of you, Bebop, but I'm fine.
Uhh, you mean like... have aspirations, or see things when they sleep?
Oh, when you sleep, silly! No one cares about your "aspirations".
Sorry mate. Is what it is.
I hope to meet her one day.
Well, if all goes well, you'll get the chance.
Mr. Bebop, I have a question.
I heard that you fight in the Bear Pit. But when I went, there were no bears. It wasn't even a pit! It was a circle with two people punchin' each other!
How could I have fun when there were no bears?! They should call it the Human Circle.
Your attachment to your charge makes you weak, Bebop.
No. She gives me something to fight for.
I'm sure she's a lovely woman. The fact remains that if I considered you a threat, I would go through her to get to you.
I'm sure you'll give me no reason to say hello.
You're not like the other organics.
My dear scrap golem... I'm not like any man you've ever met in your life.
I've got my eye on you, Seven.
Bebop, you should be relieved, not suspicious. Thanks to me, your precious Miss Shelly has a chance to live out the rest of her pleasant yet unremarkable life.
Seen you fight before. You got a flair for the dramatic.
I've found that pit fighting is two parts violence, one part theatrics. You should give it a try sometime. Bet you'd be a natural.
You know, there was a time in my life when I probably woulda taken you up on that... but I like the new path I'm on.
You think some knives are really gonna be enough?
If I'm the one holdin' 'em, yeah.
When I pull 'em in, you're gonna have to work fast.
Don't worry, Bebop. I'll make short work of 'em.
Never seen you in the Bear Pit.
Well, if I miss another car payment you just might.
I've been known to bake a biscuit or two for Miss Shelly, why do you ask?
There's a... whiff of cinnamon around you.
Made snickerdoodles this mornin'. Quite the nose you got there. Got any other party tricks?
You look like the rough-and-tumble type.
That's probably the nicest way anyone's ever described me.
We're not gonna dwell on that.
I don't think I've ever seen a priest like you before.
That's good. It means your life hasn't been in peril.
Father... I'm not a religious man. Not a man at all, really, but... would you mind saying a prayer for Miss Shelly?
M-m, of course... Lord, please guide Bebop's hand. May his aim be true, and his resolve unshaken by the screams of his enemies. For he fights not for himself, but for the life of a good woman. Amen.
That was... significantly more violent than I expected.
Lay your traps, Father. I'll be sure to pull them right towards 'em.
You talk very fondly of your creator.
Miss Shelly is a good woman.
Must be nice having someone like that in your life.
After the ritual, I could introduce you to-
No imposition, I insist! People like us need to stick together.
I'm, uh... sorry you don't know who made ya.
Maybe it's a good thing. Not everyone's parents are good people.
You've been talkin' to Pocket, haven't ya?
I'm not trying to be rude, but... how much of you is... original you? Well, not original per se, but-
I see where you're going. No, I haven't had to swap out parts yet. Probably should. My left arm keeps popping off... but it doesn't feel right to discard it when I don't even know who they were.
I'm excited to work with you, Bebop!
It's nice knowing the enemy won't be grabbing me out of the air.
True. I can be a right bastard.
You're the one I read about in the papers, right?
That known associates of John Hathorne and the Friends of Humanity have been winding up dead.
That could be me or Wesley.
They were shot in the 'ead. With a high-powered rifle.
That sounds rather, uh... intense! I think I'll let you be.
Ms. Shelly sounds like a nice lady.
Do you think she'd like being in a cube?
Y'know what? She might! After the ritual, come over and say hi! I'll make biscuits.
Hey, Viscous! I'm not organic. Why does The Cube heal me?
I hear Lash doesn't like you.
You take care of an old lady, right?
You want me to, uh... tsk, move some of her medication?
How did I get stuck working with the choir boy robot?
Me pulling them in gonna be a problem?
Nah... I like to work up close.
...Are you supposed to be in prison?
Well, I mean, I killed my parole officer, so probably... It's a-that's a joke. I got jokes. He- he probably survived.
Hey Bebop, you lookin' for work?
Why are you wasting your time at a junkyard?
Helping Miss Shelly's never a waste of time.
How long are you planning on lying to that lady?
No. You just lie to yourself.
If today goes well, I won't have a reason to fight.
Well, in that case... let's go out with a bang.
やつが噂の殺戮マシーンか？ (So this is the killing machine I've heard about?)
Er, apologies, I don't speak Japanese.
I heard you know how to fight.
Yamato, I don't particularly care if I disappoint you or not. I'm here for Miss Shelly. Not you.
I'll knock 'em out of the fight!
You ever punch a man a city block? Hell of a feeling.
I can't wait to throw hands.
Time to get in a scrap.
The ol' left hand won me a lot of purses. I'm in.
Sometimes you need a laser. Sometimes you just need your fist.
No one hits harder than me.
There ain't a man alive I can't send flying.
[Cough] You're a live one, aren't ya?
Why don't you play with our Guardian?
Have fun playin' with our Walker!
You want the Patron? Here ya go!
Sometimes, when I put these on people, they're like: "Oh no! What can I do?" And it's like: Nothing, mate! You're gonna blow up!
Is sticking someone with a bomb they can't remove fair? Of course not. If it was, I wouldn't be doin' it.
The only thing that makes this better is sending them flying before the bomb goes off.
Another thing humans are bad at: Surviving explosions.
I love the looks on their faces.
The inevitable is a hell of a thing.
A gift from me, to them.
I just love giving these to people!
I got enough of these for everyone!
You, uh, you got somethin' on ya, mate!
Nothin' you can do now mate.
You can try to run! But it won't help.
'Fraid you got yourself a little problem!
Urgh, let's see which one of us dies first!
Didn' see me comin', did ya?
If they think they can run away, well... I've got a surprise for 'em.
Nothing beats catching some poor bastard unaware.
Ready to give the ol' metal handshake.
Well, look at what I got.
I'll pull 'em all over the battlefield.
Oh, I hope I find someone walking all by themselves.
Me and me mates are 'bout to pick a fight!
Now, this is how you start a fight!
Watchu do way over there, ey?
I'll disintergrate the lot of them.
Got the ol' death ray primed and ready!
Ready to melt some faces off!
You'd think shooting people with a giant laser would get old... but nah. It's always satisfying.
I can't wait to fire this thing!
Now this, is a proper laser.
This'll blow a hole through anyone!
What's not to love about a giant laser, eh?
Let's see 'em standing against something like this.
Now, that's how you send a message.
This thing will end some fights.
I'll cut through all of ya!
Gettin' close to me was never gonna work out well for ya.
Nothing like a good 'ol fist fight to get the proverbial blood pumpin'!
It don't matter how big you are, I'll take anyone to task.
This streak's come to an end!
Thought you'd get the best of me, did ya?!
Oh, we took care of them!
We're a hell of a team!
Always a pleasure workin' with ya.
If you think I'm gonna slow down, I got bad news for ya!
What's the matter, organics? Can't hang with ol' Bebop?
I got hooks for all of ya!
Oh, you wanted to fight me? Well, here I am!
Lash wishes he could be this good.
You don't have a chance in hell!
Take a look at me now, Lash. Take a look at me!
I'll take on all of ya!
They won't be using their tricks for much longer.
Let me deal with their magic.
I'm not worried about their abilities!
Time to get in the thick of it!
I can work on my abilities.
Need to find time to train.
I should check out the store.
I should pop by the shop.
I can afford some better items!
I wonder what I could afford now.
I could afford a quality relic.
Might be time to spend these souls...
I should check out what I can get at the store.
I can get some top-shelf merchandise!
Nothin' in the shop I can't afford!
Time to get the best gear out there!
You ain't layin' another 'and on me.
You messed around and ya found out!
Now what do we have here?
Now who would leave these lyin' around?
If they're gonna drop it, I'm gonna pick it up!
We're gonna complete the ritual in no time!
Oh, they're gettin' salty about that!
Another part of the ritual complete!
They wanna kill me, they'll have to try harder then that!
I need to keep me wits about me!
Don't got any backup... Need to be careful.
Of course, I outlived the lot of 'em!
Hard to find good help, innit?
Looks like it's just me still standin'.
There may be too many of 'em!
No point in throwin' me life away.
Might be time to regroup with the others.
We need to be smart, they have the Rejuvenator!
Gotta get back in the fight.
We're gonna win this, and I'm gonna look good doin' it!
Can't let the rest of the team have all the fun!
Might wanna pull back a bit...
Lash wishes he could be this good.
Don't worry Ms. Shelly, I won't let you down.
I, for one, am looking forward to proving I'm better than Lash!
Stay close to me. I'll be bringing the trouble to us.
I wasn't built for fighting, but I'm damn good at it.
Ms. Shelly probably wouldn't approve of what I'm about to do. Unfortunately for them, she's at home, resting.
I've been waiting for this moment.
Now that was one helluva fight.
They killed Lash! Maybe they're not all bad after all!
You ain't gonna stop me, Abrams!
No one's getting between me and helping Ms. Shelly!
Well he was a bit much.
He's got Lash's ego without Lash's talent.
Looks like that fancy school never taught you how to win a fight.
A high school fencing tournament isn't the same thing as a real fight, Apollo.
You brought a sword to fight a golem? Not as bright as I thought.
It was like the budget version of Lash!
I tire of people like him.
I'm not some organic that's easy to kill!
She was tougher than she looked.
She had a big heart, but it wasn't enough.
You know... I'm starting to think that she might actually be a unicorn.
That was not a normal doorman.
I need to remember to cancel Ms. Shelly's brunch at the Baroness.
The Doorman is out of the fight!
What do I look like, Drifter, a frail organic?
Picked the wrong side to back, Dynamo.
No black holes for you, Professor!
Wish we were fighting together, Dynamo!
That girl needs a hug from her parents.
Little too old for the vengeance game, aren't ya mate?
You're good, Haze, but you're not me.
You were never gonna beat me, Holliday!
I did what I had to do.
She never should have challenged me!
Your freeze ray was never gonna get the job done, mate!
Nothin' personal, Kelvin. You had to go.
I'm better than you, Lash, just deal with it!
You see that? I killed Lash! I. Killed. Lash.
Like I told ya, Lash: beatin' me was a fluke!
Pity she's not working with us.
Welp, Fairfax Industries is down an engineer.
I bet she could've given me a tune-up!
So much for asking her to speak to Ms. Shelly.
McGinnis won't be bothering us for a while!
There's always someone better than you, Mina!
A little humility would do her wonders.
Mina, you weren't ready to face someone like me.
Tunnel Rats have been dealt with!
You two were tough, just not tough enough!
I bet Ms. Shelly would have liked her!
She won't be shielding her friends anytime soon!
We don't need to worry about Paradox for a while!
Paradox, you're not on my level!
You've never fought someone like me, Paradox!
Don't think Miss Shelly would approve of that one.
That little guy didn't have a chance in 'ell!
What the hell was that thing?
Nah. Sorry, Rem. Not really into nappin'.
Your knives were never gonna be enough.
Spend less time on your hair and more time learning how to fight!
There's always someone tougher than you, Shiv; remember that.
She put up a hell of a fight.
Not the first time I knocked the snot out of a werewolf.
I've fought tougher in the Bear Pit!
You ain't standin' in my way, Victor!
I'm sorry for your pain, Victor.
Aw, slink back to the Deep, would ya?!
That cube was never gonna save you from me.
Viscous won't be botherin' us for a while!
I can't believe she lasted this long without being stabbed and left for dead in a gutter!
Fall on your sword, Yamato! Save us all some time!
I'm not getting cut up by the likes of you!
They're going to be salty about that.
The guardian will deal with them.
Not bad for a tin can.
You're my kind of asshole, Bebop.
That was petty, and I loved it.
I like the way you think, tin man!
They can't be happy about that.
Oooh, that's not very nice, Bebop.
They won't be too happy about that.
This isn't going to end well for them.
Our defenses will tear them apart!
They're about to have a real bad day!
Hope the Guardian can help take 'em out.
Bebop, that was a dick move!.. I love it!
Let's let the Guardian do some work.
The guardians will deal with them.
Let the guardian deal with that one.
Don't die before I can kill you, Bebop!
They took out Bebop!.. I'm cool with it.
They took out Bebop! Aww, no surprise there!
Bebop?.. Urgh, I can heal you.
So... what does it feel to be a winner, Bebop? [Chuckle] It's pretty nice, huh? You're welcome.
Good luck doing... whatever a golem does.
Bebop, you're not useless after all!
Now, let's go finish them off!
I like the way you think, Bebop!
The Guardian will deal with them.
Time for the Guardian to earn its keep.
I like it when you fight dirty, Bebop.
The golem is a cruel one, isn't he.
I like the way you think, Bebop.
The guardian will deal with them.
Now's our chance to finish them off!
Oh no. They took out Bebop.
Our defences will take care of them.
Be with you when I can, Bebop.
容赦ないな、あの機械は。
ビバップの戦い方には好感が持てるな。
That thing never had a chance!
No no no no no no!
Y'gotta be faster than that, Bebop!
That laser supposed to be impressive?
I'm too fast for you, Bebop.
I'm not some drunk pit fighter, Bebop! I'm a real talent.
I don't see why Lash had trouble stopping him.
What chance did a machine have against me?
Never stand still in a fight.
You really are making this easy for me, Bebop.
Oh, just stand there and die!
You wanna mess with me, Bebop?
We all got problems, Bebop, Miss Shelly's ain't special.
You ain't gettin' sympathy from me, Bebop.
You're making this too easy, Bebop!
Thanks for standin' in one place!
Psh, that'll shut down the laser.
The scrap golem is no more.
We don't need to worry about Bebop.
Keep your hooks off my friends.
Your creator should've built a more competent son.
All you did was make yourself a stationary target.
You didn't think that would work, did you?
You're not grabbin' my friends, Bebop.
The scrap golem is out of commission.
I'm sorry about Ms. Shelly, Bebop.
He was a good son... makes me feel kind of bad.
My light show's a little better.
Ya just gonna stand there, Bebop?
Not a great plan, tin man.
Bebop is no longer a concern.
Go back to the scrapyard, Bebop.
Tend to Ms. Shelly, Bebop. It's safer for you.
Your flesh may be iron, but your heart is too soft for this.
